quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: The clinic used to see patients on a first-come, first-served basis. Long waits became common, and complaints grew. Last year, management switched to an appointment system, and waiting times have since ____ considerably.
quests.hint: A new appointment system, introduced to fix long waits, should have this effect on waiting times.
quests.explanation: 'Shortened' logically follows from switching systems specifically to solve the long-wait problem.

quests.instruction: Choose the word that best completes the passage.
quests.passage: Two years ago, the village had no mobile signal at all. A new tower changed that almost overnight. Today, residents who once relied entirely on landlines say the change has been ____.
quests.hint: Going from no signal to full coverage 'almost overnight' suggests a dramatic, not minor, effect.
quests.explanation: 'Transformative' fits a dramatic before-and-after shift, matching the scale of change described.

quests.instruction: Select the option that fits the context.
quests.passage: The bakery's original recipe used butter imported from a small farm. When that farm closed, the owners had to find a substitute. Regular customers noticed the difference immediately and were quick to point out that the bread no longer tasted ____.
quests.hint: The phrase needs to directly echo the comparison being made between old and new versions.
quests.explanation: 'The same' directly completes the comparison implied by customers noticing a difference from before.

quests.instruction: Choose the word that best completes the passage.
quests.passage: The airline cut costs by reducing in-flight meals and legroom. Fares dropped as a result, and bookings rose sharply. However, customer satisfaction scores, once among the highest in the industry, have since ____.
quests.hint: Cutting comfort while satisfaction was 'once among the highest' implies a steep, negative change.
quests.explanation: 'Plummeted' fits a dramatic drop, matching the contrast with formerly top-tier satisfaction scores.

quests.instruction: Select the option that fits the context.
quests.passage: The museum's director wanted to attract younger visitors without alienating longtime patrons. The solution was a series of evening events mixing art with live music. Attendance figures suggest the strategy has largely ____.
quests.hint: This phrase means a plan succeeded, matching the positive attendance figures mentioned.
quests.explanation: 'Paid off' means succeeded, fitting attendance figures described as supporting the strategy.

quests.instruction: Complete the sentence with the most suitable word.
quests.passage: The factory had promised to cut water usage by twenty percent within two years. Independent inspectors visited last month and confirmed the target had, in fact, been ____.
quests.hint: Inspectors 'confirmed' the goal was met — the word should show it was met or surpassed, not merely reached vaguely.
quests.explanation: 'Exceeded' fits inspectors confirming a strong outcome, going beyond simply meeting the target.

quests.instruction: Select the option that fits the context.
quests.passage: For years, the two neighboring restaurants competed fiercely for the same customers, often lowering prices to outdo each other. When one finally closed, few expected the survivor to raise its prices. Yet within months, that is exactly what ____.
quests.hint: This verb simply completes the reference to the event just described.
quests.explanation: 'Happened' is the natural, neutral verb completing 'that is exactly what' referring to a prior event.

quests.instruction: Complete the sentence with the most suitable word.
quests.passage: The charity spent a decade building trust with the local community before launching its first fundraising campaign there. That patience appears to have ____, since the campaign raised far more than expected.
quests.hint: A decade of patience leading to unexpectedly high results describes a strategy that succeeded.
quests.explanation: 'Paid off' means the earlier effort succeeded, matching the unexpectedly strong fundraising result.

quests.instruction: Choose the word that makes the passage clear and natural.
quests.passage: The company's founder always insisted that quality mattered more than speed. Under new leadership, that philosophy appears to have been ____, as recent product launches have been rushed and poorly tested.
quests.hint: Rushed, poorly tested launches suggest the old philosophy is no longer being followed.
quests.explanation: 'Abandoned' fits evidence — rushed launches — that the old quality-first philosophy was dropped.

quests.instruction: Complete the sentence with the most suitable word.
quests.passage: When the new highway opened, local shop owners worried that drivers would simply pass through town without stopping. Six months later, foot traffic on the main street tells a different story: it has actually ____.
quests.hint: 'A different story' from the worried prediction implies the opposite of fewer customers happened.
quests.explanation: 'Increased' contrasts with the fear of fewer visitors, matching 'a different story' from what was feared.

quests.instruction: Choose the word that makes the passage clear and natural.
quests.passage: The report warned that without intervention, the fish population in the lake would collapse within a decade. Conservationists acted quickly, introducing new regulations on fishing. The latest survey suggests those measures have ____ the decline, at least for now.
quests.hint: Quick action followed by a positive survey outcome implies the earlier decline was stopped.
quests.explanation: 'Halted' fits regulations working to stop the predicted collapse, matching the positive survey update.

quests.instruction: Pick the word that best fits the meaning of the passage.
quests.passage: The two departments had operated separately for years, each with its own budget and staff. When they were merged last spring, many employees feared job losses. So far, however, the merger has led to ____ growth rather than cuts.
quests.hint: Fear of job losses followed by growth 'rather than cuts' suggests the outcome surprised people.
quests.explanation: 'Unexpected' matches an outcome that contradicts the widespread fear of job losses.

quests.instruction: Choose the word that makes the passage clear and natural.
quests.passage: The bridge was originally designed to carry light traffic between two small villages. Decades later, it now serves as the main route for thousands of commuters daily, a burden the aging structure was never ____ to handle.
quests.hint: The phrase pairs with 'to handle,' describing the original engineering purpose of the bridge.
quests.explanation: 'Built to handle' collocates naturally with engineering capacity, unlike 'hoped' or 'planned.'

quests.instruction: Pick the word that best fits the meaning of the passage.
quests.passage: Sales of the tablet were strong at launch but fell steadily over the following year. Rather than discontinuing the product, the manufacturer chose to ____ it with a significant price cut.
quests.hint: Cutting the price to attract a different market segment is a strategy for changing a product's place in the market.
quests.explanation: 'Reposition' means to change how a product is marketed, matching a strategic price cut.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: The professor's lectures were famously dense, packed with references few undergraduates could follow. It wasn't until his notes were published as a book, years later, that his ideas finally reached a ____ audience.
quests.hint: Publishing as a book, versus dense lectures for few students, implies reaching more people.
quests.explanation: 'Wider' fits a book reaching more readers than the originally small lecture audience.

quests.instruction: Pick the word that best fits the meaning of the passage.
quests.passage: The startup's first product failed spectacularly, losing almost all its early investors. Most founders would have given up. Instead, the team used what they learned to build a second product that ____ became an industry standard.
quests.hint: This adverb shows the success came after a period of time, following the earlier failure.
quests.explanation: 'Eventually' shows the success happened over time, following the earlier setback described.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: The committee spent three meetings debating a name for the new park before finally agreeing. Ironically, the name they chose was one that had been ____ in the very first meeting and initially dismissed.
quests.hint: This verb describes an idea suggested early on, before it was rejected and then later accepted.
quests.explanation: 'Proposed' fits an idea first suggested, then dismissed, then finally chosen — matching the irony.

quests.instruction: Choose the word that best completes the passage.
quests.passage: The hospital's new wing was meant to ease overcrowding in the emergency room. Instead, word spread quickly about shorter wait times, and the wing has ____ attracted even more patients than the old building did.
quests.hint: A solution to overcrowding that causes more crowding is an unexpected, contradictory outcome.
quests.explanation: 'Ironically' captures the contradiction — a fix for overcrowding that drew even more patients.

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank with the correct word.
quests.passage: The company's founder built her reputation on hands-on leadership, personally reviewing every major decision. As the business grew to thousands of employees, that approach became increasingly ____, and she was eventually forced to delegate.
quests.hint: Personally reviewing everything becomes harder to sustain as a company grows very large.
quests.explanation: 'Impractical' fits an approach that no longer works at scale, forcing delegation.

quests.instruction: Choose the word that best completes the passage.
quests.passage: Early drafts of the policy included strict penalties for late filings. After pushback from small business owners, those penalties were significantly ____ in the final version.
quests.hint: Pushback leading to change in the final version suggests the penalties became less harsh.
quests.explanation: 'Softened' means made less harsh, fitting penalties reduced after business owners' complaints.

quests.instruction: Select the option that fits the context.
quests.passage: The band's earlier albums were commercial failures, largely ignored by critics and fans alike. Their latest release, by contrast, has been met with near-universal ____.
quests.hint: This noun means widespread praise, the opposite reaction to earlier being 'ignored.'
quests.explanation: 'Acclaim' means strong praise, contrasting sharply with earlier albums being ignored.

quests.instruction: Choose the word that best completes the passage.
quests.passage: The town's only cinema closed a decade ago, and residents had to drive forty minutes to watch a film. A local entrepreneur recently reopened it, and despite skepticism, the venture has proven surprisingly ____.
quests.hint: Despite doubts, a business succeeding financially is described using this adjective.
quests.explanation: 'Viable' means able to succeed financially, fitting a venture that overcame initial skepticism.

quests.instruction: Select the option that fits the context.
quests.passage: The two scientists disagreed publicly for years over the correct interpretation of their shared data. It was only after a third researcher reanalyzed everything independently that the dispute was finally ____.
quests.hint: Independent reanalysis bringing a long disagreement to a close is described by this verb.
quests.explanation: 'Settled' means resolved, matching the dispute ending after independent reanalysis.

quests.instruction: Complete the sentence with the most suitable word.
quests.passage: The government initially described the spending cuts as temporary, necessary only until the economy recovered. Three years later, with no sign of reversal, many now view them as effectively ____.
quests.hint: Three years with no reversal, despite being called temporary, suggests they are lasting indefinitely.
quests.explanation: 'Permanent' contrasts with the original claim of 'temporary,' matching years without reversal.

quests.instruction: Select the option that fits the context.
quests.passage: The city's bike-share program was launched with great fanfare and generous subsidies. When the subsidies ended last year, usage dropped so sharply that officials are now questioning whether the program was ever truly ____ in the first place.
quests.hint: A program that collapses once subsidies end suggests it could not support itself long-term.
quests.explanation: 'Sustainable' means able to continue without ongoing support, questioned once subsidies stopped.

quests.instruction: Complete the sentence with the most suitable word.
quests.passage: The vaccine's initial trials showed promising results, but researchers were careful not to draw firm conclusions until a larger study could ____ those early findings.
quests.hint: This verb means to provide supporting evidence for something already suspected.
quests.explanation: 'Corroborate' means to confirm with further evidence, fitting cautious scientific language.

quests.instruction: Choose the word that makes the passage clear and natural.
quests.passage: The novel was rejected by a dozen publishers before finally finding one willing to take a chance on it. Within a year, that same manuscript had become the best-selling book of the ____.
quests.hint: This noun completes a superlative phrase about a time period, matching 'within a year.'
quests.explanation: 'Decade' completes a natural superlative scope for a bestselling book's ranking.

quests.instruction: Complete the sentence with the most suitable word.
quests.passage: For years, the company's annual reports emphasized steady, if unspectacular, growth. This year's report reads very differently: profits have nearly doubled, and the language throughout is notably more ____.
quests.hint: Doubled profits would likely change the tone of a report from modest to something more assured.
quests.explanation: 'Confident' fits a tone shift matching dramatically improved results this year.

quests.instruction: Choose the word that makes the passage clear and natural.
quests.passage: The council had promised residents that the new bypass would ease congestion on the high street. Traffic counts released this week ____ that promise, showing a twenty percent drop in vehicles.
quests.hint: A drop in traffic matching what was promised means the data supports the earlier claim.
quests.explanation: 'Confirm' fits data supporting a prior promise, matching the reported drop in traffic.

quests.instruction: Pick the word that best fits the meaning of the passage.
quests.passage: The restaurant's chef trained for years under a demanding mentor who rarely gave praise. Perhaps because of that, the chef's own kitchen today runs on a philosophy that could not be more ____: constant encouragement over harsh criticism.
quests.hint: A reaction against a harsh mentor implies the chef's own approach is the opposite.
quests.explanation: 'Different' fits a philosophy that is the opposite of the demanding mentor's style.
